SKILL · MIT

浏览器会话 · browser-relay

Manage task-owned browsers, authenticated sessions, target ownership, and cleanup.

Get complete Skill on GitHub ↗

When to use it

Use for retained login or isolated browsing. Recipients configure their own browser carrier; private sessions are never distributed.

“Use this Skill for my task, first checking the companion methods and actual tools it needs.”

What is included

Includes the method and configuration guidance. The package README specifies resources, scripts, companion Skills, and external tools. Download relevant companions and bind your own environment.

After downloading

Open the GitHub package directory above; clone the repository or use GitHub’s Code → Download ZIP, then extract the complete skills/browser-relay/ folder. Give that folder to a client supporting Skills and follow its installation or discovery mechanism to load SKILL.md and its resources; unzipping alone is not installation. Without native Skill support, an assistant can read the entrypoint and needed resources as task guidance.

Ask naturally; if the client supports explicit invocation, select browser-relay。The client’s existing authority, authentication, and tool boundaries remain in force.
